result:
**The proposed answer \(P_X(t)=t^{14}\) is not correct.** The argument rests on an unjustified claim: that \(X\) is a rational homology 14-sphere. The stratum dimension count is right, but the top-degree homology is wrong.

**Dimension count.** The four real roots contribute 4 parameters. The remaining degree-10 factor \(q\) has 5 conjugate pairs, contributing 10 real parameters. So \(\dim_{\mathbb R} S = 14\), which is correct.

**Structure of \(Y\).** Limits of polynomials in \(S\) have the form \((x-a)^3(x-b)(x-c)(x-d)^3\,q\) with \(a\le b\le c\le d\) real and \(q\) monic of degree 10 with \(q\ge 0\) on \(\mathbb R\). The set \(N\) of such \(q\) is a closed convex subset of \(\mathbb R^{10}\) with nonempty interior and nonempty boundary. The boundary consists of \(q\) with real double roots, which arise when a conjugate pair collides on the real axis.

**Why \(\widetilde H_{14}(X;\mathbb Q)=0\).** Near a generic point of that boundary, \(Y\) looks like a half-space: nearby polynomials in \(Y\) have \(q\) with a conjugate pair, while perturbations that split the double root into two real roots are not in \(Y\). So \(Y\) has a 13-dimensional boundary \(\partial Y\neq\emptyset\). A compact connected 14-dimensional space with nonempty boundary has no nonzero top rational homology. Equivalently, \(H^{14}_c(Y;\mathbb Q)\cong H_0(Y,\partial Y;\mathbb Q)=0\) in the manifold-with-boundary case, and the singular strata from collisions among \(r_i\) do not supply a fundamental class. Hence \(\widetilde H_{14}(X;\mathbb Q)=0\), contradicting the proposed answer.

**Sanity check on a smaller analogue.** For monic cubics with three real roots, the closure is homeomorphic to \(\mathbb R\times(\text{closed half-plane})\). Its one-point compactification is contractible, so the reduced homology is zero. This supports the view that such closures have boundary and do not give a sphere.

I have not fully computed the correct polynomial; the singular strata make a complete computation more involved. But the proposed value \(t^{14}\) is not justified and is contradicted by the boundary structure of \(Y\).

VERDICT: REJECT
